compactRecord.rs: Walk canal at dusk for gas-lamp reflections; mid-Feb Snow Light Path lines the water with candles in snow lanterns. Allow extra time for Otaru sushi-dōri.
compactRecord.td: 1923-completed canal lined with sandstone warehouses, the surviving emblem of Otaru's herring-era port wealth; Sakaimachi street prolongs the stroll with Meiji-Taishō glassworks, music-box, sushi alley and the Bank of Japan Otaru Museum.
